label: Q01
question: This table gives each value's cruise and station but no time or position. We take both from the CalCOFI bottle cast at the same station on the same cruise. Is that the right cast (the one the size-fractionation samples came from)?
context: The ingest matches each row to the calcofi_bottle cast with the same cruise_key and site_key; rows with no such cast are held out and listed in the notebook. Where a station was occupied twice on a cruise, the cast nearest the 15th of the designated month is taken.
proposed_answer: Yes: the samples came from that station's CalCOFI hydrographic (bottle) cast; use its time and position.

question: Station IDs on lines 76.7, 81.8, 83.3 and 86.7 are written with the line rounded to a whole number (077.0, 082.0, 083.0, 087.0). We map them to the official stations (e.g. 077.0 060.0 -> 76.7 60.0; 082.0 047.0 -> 81.8 46.9). Is that right, and is 087.0 039.5 station 86.7 40.0?
context: 25 of the 48 source stations are mapped (metadata/cce-lter/chl-size-fractionated/station_crosswalk.csv). 087.0 039.5 (11 rows) had no exact official match and was held out on the first render (411 of 422 matched).
proposed_answer: Yes: the lines are the official 76.7, 81.8, 83.3 and 86.7.
answer: Yes. The lines are the official 76.7, 81.8, 83.3 and 86.7, and 087.0 039.5 is station 86.7 40.0: calcofi_bottle (release v2026.10.05) has a cast at 086.7 040.0 on all 11 cruises these rows come from and none at 039.5, the neighbouring stations on the line are 35 and 45, and the source has no separate 087.0 040.0 row. Mapped in station_crosswalk.csv; the 11 rows are published.
